description: Search the federal UID register (BFS) by entity name; it covers every UID holder (companies, associations, foundations, sole proprietors, public administrations), not just commercial-register entries. Optionally narrow by canton ('ZH') or postcode ('8001'); these filters are applied to the returned candidates. Returns UID, name, legal form, address, VAT and commercial-register status. Example: name='Pro Natura', name='Gemeinde Köniz'.

name.description: Entity name or fragment, e.g. 'Migros', 'Verein Pro Velo'

name: search_uid_register
title: Search the UID register by name
